text: Decent medical care at super-low prices as it's run by BMA. Medical, dental and planned parenthood services. Diabetes, high-blood-pressure, pre-natal clinics on certain days, too. Less busy time is the after-hour clinic from 4:30-8 pm, the best time is around 6 pm. One can usually find parking in the Takam Temple, 5-minute walk away in the nearby Soi Chaloem Phrakiat 22.

I came to the doctor because I had a cold, and it was my fault for not wearing a mask. A woman inside told me to go buy one, but it was raining heavily and there were no nearby shops. I was confused; didn't this public health center have masks to give away or sell that they would tell a patient to go buy one in the rain? And the way she spoke was... um...

I tried calling ahead to ask about the time but got no response, so I came to get a medical certificate for my driver's license. General medical services are open in the evening at 4:00 PM, but there is no queue selection until 4:15 PM, when queue number 1 begins. The total time required to apply is approximately 45 minutes per queue (20 minutes to wait for a call, 20 minutes to wait for the doctor, and 5 minutes to pay). Parking is available on the opposite side for 50 baht, or at Wat Taklam for 20 baht.
Do children get vaccinated every Tuesday? I'm taking my child there. If anyone knows, please let me know.

Another option for people with COVID-19: Get tested, receive medication, done.
Not crowded, staff are helpful and explain things in detail. Universal Health Coverage (Gold Card) holders pay 11 baht, Social Security holders pay a little over 100 baht. Much more worthwhile than going to a hospital with your existing coverage. The only long wait is for medication. You can walk in and register. This isn't just a clinic; all health centers have this kind of service.

Is there anything negative here? Slow, not punctual, the nurse walked around slowly, too relaxed. Called for medical history at 4 pm, then it turned out to be just a small wound cleaning after 4 pm. *Quite bad.* Was told to go buy a mask at the shop next door, which was a car repair shop. Hello?! And it was hard to find!

Both nurses were incredibly kind and friendly.
They gave excellent advice. This place is the best, even better than some other hospitals. I highly recommend it. You won't be disappointed. If you are, contact me and I'll give you a toy car! 😅🤣 …

text: I took time off work to bring my child to get vaccinated. The queue was full since 12:30. When I asked the staff inside if they were accepting more people, they said they weren't accepting any more people and to come back next Tuesday.

***This post was made before receiving an apology.***
This was my second time using their service, but it was terrible due to the way the service provider spoke. I had called to confirm before arriving, but upon arrival, I was treated rudely and emotionally. While there weren't any explicitly impolite words, the tone was clearly emotional. As a service provider, such behavior is unacceptable. They acted as if we didn't know or check beforehand, even though the center should have the information. They raised their voice at us, and after saying that, they said they would check. When we asked if there was a record of the issue, we received no answer, and they acted as if nothing had happened. There was no apology offered. Terrible experience. 👎
***After an hour, we spoke with them, and at 2 PM, we received an apology.***
***The issue was not with the service itself, but rather the tone and demeanor of the staff.***

I'm giving this place 1 star because we usually take our son for vaccinations at a private hospital or clinic. The older male doctor with glasses, however, spoke to us very kindly.

I also saw other staff members speaking rudely to others. I don't understand why they're like this. Are they stressed about something? If anyone in charge or from the local council reads this, please address this issue immediately.

For us, we'll probably go back to taking our son to a private hospital or clinic.

I came to see the doctor today, and I have something to tell you. There was an accident in front of the hospital, but it was an accident that made me very happy to see. When I heard the sound of a car crash, the doctors and nurses ran out to see the injured people so quickly!
In less than two seconds after hearing the sound, the doctors and nurses were at the injured people. It was something that impressed me so much. Thank you very much to all the doctors and nurses.
I wish you all good health.

Overall, it's great. It's close to home, very convenient, and the wait time is short. All the doctors are lovely and kind. I took my child for a vaccination and it was quick. The nurses were very gentle. All the staff are wonderful.
